_doc: Bytes per unit for gtdb_postings.py, card B-18 (planning/measurements/2026-11-10_phase_b_exit.md section 6). Sources: 'ladder P1' = stage P1 of the import ladder (250 complete GTDB genomes, 1.02 Gbp, 539 contigs, 927,920 genes; release rL.2 at /tmp/if2453/ladder/root on wilkcomp02), measured 2026-11-10 by column_bytes.py on its manifest (code f9af5b6, before card B-17); 'golden' = the golden-set build of 2026-11-10 by build_s0.py at the B-18 code (Pfam 38.2, MMseqs2 clusters). 'minus removed columns' subtracts the column-chunk bytes of the columns card B-17 removed (derived).
